{{Quote|The Tomb of Hakagram Graush remained silent to my queries, and the throne where Sorzus Syn once sat contained no mocking, imperious specter.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''throne''' of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sorzus Syn]] was located in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] visited the throne in hopes of facing a [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]]. Apparently, Plagueis encountered no ghost there, to his great disappointment.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sorzus Syn's throne was first mentioned in the resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
